description: Get latest retained Ondo display prices and minute OHLC. Preserve source/receipt ages, evaluatedAt, conflicts and collector gaps; fresh is a 120-second policy at evaluatedAt, not an execution guarantee. Missing values are not zero. This does not open an issuer subscription or supply history.
